category: Define Roles and Responsibilities for AI (PO)
subcategory_text: Define AI-specific roles and responsibilities (model owner, MLOps engineer, red team, AI risk officer) and integrate them with conventional secure-development responsibilities.
implementation_examples: Assign a model-card owner per deployed model
Identify a red-team lead for AI-specific adversarial testing
Define escalation paths for AI incidents (drift, jailbreaks, data leakage)
assessment_objectives: Determine whether AI-specific roles are defined and staffed.
Determine whether escalation paths for AI incidents exist.
